glosses.notes: Used for the shore or bank where people stand, land, or bring boats in.

examples.sentence: 天刚亮的时候，几个人已经在岸上整理网，等船一到，就把前一天晚上打到的鱼一条一条搬下来。
雨停以后，孩子们沿着河岸慢慢走，一边听老师讲这条河过去怎样影响周围村子的生活。
船还没有靠岸，站在码头上的工作人员就先挥手提醒，让游客按顺序准备下船。

example_translations.translation: At daybreak, several people were already on the shore sorting nets, waiting for the boat to arrive so they could carry down the fish caught the night before one by one.
After the rain stopped, the children walked slowly along the riverbank while listening to the teacher explain how the river had affected life in the surrounding village.
Before the boat had reached shore, the staff on the dock were already waving to remind the visitors to get ready to disembark in order.

glosses.notes: Usually means a real case or example used to explain a rule, problem, or decision.

examples.sentence: 老师上课没有先讲抽象的道理，而是先拿一个校园里的真实案例，让大家自己判断问题出在哪里。
公司开会讨论服务改进的时候，经理把上个月收到的投诉整理成几个案例，要求每个部门提出办法。
医生解释这种治疗方案时，没有只谈数据，还讲了两个恢复得很好的案例，让家属比较容易理解。

example_translations.translation: Instead of beginning with abstract theory, the teacher first used a real case from campus life and let everyone judge where the problem lay.
When the company met to discuss service improvements, the manager organized last month's complaints into several cases and asked each department to propose solutions.
When the doctor explained this treatment plan, he did not talk only about the data; he also described two cases with strong recoveries, which made it easier for the family to understand.

glosses.notes: Means to massage the body, usually to relax muscles or ease soreness.

examples.sentence: 他连续坐了十几个小时的车，到旅馆以后先请工作人员帮他按摩肩膀和后背，想让身体快一点放松下来。
奶奶说自己最近总是腰酸，所以社区医院每周都会安排一次简单的按摩，帮助她晚上睡得好一点。
比赛结束以后，医生一边给几个队员按摩小腿，一边提醒他们回去以后还要继续拉伸。

example_translations.translation: After sitting in the car for more than ten hours straight, he asked the hotel staff to massage his shoulders and back first so his body could relax more quickly.
Grandma said her lower back had been sore lately, so the community clinic arranged a simple massage once a week to help her sleep a little better at night.
After the match ended, the doctor massaged several players' calves while reminding them to keep stretching after they got home.

glosses.notes: Means to hint at something indirectly instead of saying it openly.

examples.sentence: 经理没有直接点名批评谁，只是在会后暗示大家，下次再出现同样的问题就要自己先写说明。
她虽然没有马上答应，但是说到明年安排的时候已经多次暗示自己愿意去外地工作一段时间。
电影的前半段一直在暗示真正的原因另有安排，所以看到最后时观众才突然明白前面那些细节。

example_translations.translation: The manager did not criticize anyone by name; he only hinted after the meeting that if the same problem happened again, everyone would have to write an explanation first.
Although she did not agree right away, when next year's arrangements came up she hinted several times that she was willing to work in another city for a while.
The first half of the film kept hinting that the real reason lay elsewhere, so only at the end did the audience suddenly understand those earlier details.

glosses.notes: Describes something as very expensive, often beyond what most people want or can afford.

examples.sentence: 这家店里的那件大衣确实很漂亮，可是价格太昂贵，我们看了很久，最后还是决定先回去想一想。
医生说这种进口药效果不错，只是对普通家庭来说太昂贵，所以医院还在帮病人找更合适的方案。
因为维护费用十分昂贵，学校最后没有买那套设备，而是先把旧实验室重新整理了一遍。

example_translations.translation: The coat in that shop was indeed beautiful, but the price was too expensive, so after looking for a long time we still decided to go home and think about it.
The doctor said this imported medicine worked well, but it was too expensive for an ordinary family, so the hospital was still helping the patient look for a more suitable plan.
Because the upkeep costs were extremely high, the school ultimately did not buy that equipment and instead reorganized the old laboratory first.

glosses.notes: Means doing something in vain or letting effort go to waste without results.

examples.sentence: 大家准备了一个月，结果因为通知没有及时发出去，很多人根本不知道活动取消，前面的辛苦差不多都白白浪费了。
如果材料还没有看清楚就急着签字，出了问题以后再解释，前面花的时间往往就白白过去了。
他为了赶第一班车天没亮就出门，可是到了站里才发现今天停运，早起这一趟算是白白忙了。

example_translations.translation: Everyone prepared for a month, but because the notice was not sent out in time, many people never learned the event had been canceled, and almost all of the earlier effort was wasted in vain.
If you rush to sign before reading the materials carefully, then have to explain yourself after something goes wrong, the time you spent earlier is often gone for nothing.
He left before dawn to catch the first bus, but only after arriving at the station did he realize service was suspended today, so getting up early turned out to be wasted effort.

glosses.notes: Refers to office workers who mainly do professional or administrative work.

examples.sentence: 地铁一到早高峰，周围写字楼里的白领就拿着电脑包快步进站，大家都想早点赶到公司开会。
他以前一直觉得白领工作比较轻松，真正进了办公室以后才发现压力和加班一点也不少。
周末咖啡店里坐满了周围公司的白领，有的人改报告，有的人继续处理没有做完的事。

example_translations.translation: As soon as the subway hit morning rush hour, the white-collar workers from the surrounding office towers hurried into the station with their laptop bags, all wanting to reach the company early for meetings.
He had always thought white-collar work was fairly easy, but only after entering an office did he realize that the pressure and overtime were not small at all.
On weekends the cafe is full of white-collar workers from the surrounding companies; some revise reports, while others keep handling unfinished work.

glosses.notes: Means to place, set out, or arrange something in a position.

examples.sentence: 她把热菜一盘一盘摆在前面以后，爷爷还特意把最清淡的那几样往奶奶面前摆得近一点。
拍照的人让我们先别说话，只把手里的书和杯子重新摆一下，这样画面看起来会自然很多。
为了让孩子一进门就能找到自己的位置，老师把名字卡整齐地摆在每一张小桌子前面。

example_translations.translation: After she laid the hot dishes out one by one in front, Grandpa even moved the lighter ones a little closer in front of Grandma.
The person taking the pictures asked us not to speak yet and just rearrange the books and cups in our hands, because that would make the picture look much more natural.
So that the children could find their places as soon as they came in, the teacher neatly placed the name cards in front of each small desk.

glosses.notes: Means to place or arrange things in a particular spot or order.

examples.sentence: 新办公室刚整理好，大家花了整整一个下午讨论打印机和文件到底应该怎样摆放才最方便。
展览开始以前，工作人员反复调整每个灯的角度，保证墙上的画和说明牌摆放得都很舒服。
她回家以后先把房间里的资料重新摆放了一遍，然后才坐下来认真想明天发言要怎么开头。

example_translations.translation: After the new office was finally organized, everyone spent an entire afternoon discussing how the printer and the files should be arranged most conveniently.
Before the exhibition opened, the staff repeatedly adjusted the angle of each lamp to make sure the paintings and caption cards on the wall were all placed comfortably.
After she got home, she first rearranged the materials in the room and only then sat down to think seriously about how to open tomorrow's speech.

glosses.notes: A percentage point is the amount of difference between two percentage figures.

examples.sentence: 经理解释报表的时候特别提醒大家，利润上升了两个百分点，不等于收入只多了一点点。
和去年相比，这家医院的满意度提高了五个百分点，所以院长才决定把原来的服务办法继续保留下来。
专家在节目里说，哪怕失业率只下降一个百分点，对很多正在找工作的人来说都是非常明显的变化。

example_translations.translation: While explaining the report, the manager reminded everyone that profits rising by two percentage points did not mean income had increased only a tiny bit.
Compared with last year, this hospital's satisfaction rating rose by five percentage points, so the director decided to keep the original service approach in place.
The expert said on the program that even if the unemployment rate drops by just one percentage point, it is still a very noticeable change for many people looking for work.

glosses.notes: Usually refers to department-store goods or to a department store as a retail category.

examples.sentence: 老城区那家百货商店虽然开了很多年，可是每到节日以前，还是有很多人专门过去买礼物和家用品。
她妈妈以前一直在百货区上班，所以从小就很会根据客人的习惯介绍不同价格的东西。
商场决定把二楼原来的百货区重新装修，希望把年轻家庭平常最常用的用品集中在一起。

example_translations.translation: Although that department store in the old district has been open for many years, plenty of people still go there specially before holidays to buy gifts and household goods.
Her mother used to work in the department-store section, so she learned from a young age how to recommend items at different prices based on customers' habits.
The mall decided to renovate the old department-goods section on the second floor, hoping to gather the items young families use most often in one place.

glosses.notes: Means to get rid of something troubling or break free from a condition or control.

examples.sentence: 他花了很长时间才慢慢摆脱总想和别人比较的习惯，现在做决定的时候明显比以前安静多了。
医生建议她先休息几周，再配合简单训练，看看能不能早点摆脱肩膀反复发紧的老问题。
公司如果一直摆脱不了过去那套慢办法，就算多招了人，很多项目也还是赶不上时间。

example_translations.translation: It took him a long time to gradually break free from the habit of always comparing himself with others, and now he is noticeably calmer when making decisions.
The doctor advised her to rest for a few weeks and combine that with simple exercises to see whether she could get rid of the old problem of recurring tightness in her shoulder sooner.
If the company still cannot break away from its old slow methods, many projects will still miss their deadlines even if it hires more people.

glosses.notes: Means to be defeated, fail, or lose in a contest or struggle.

examples.sentence: 球队上半场一直领先，可是最后十分钟连着失误，结果还是败给了经验更足的对手。
如果只因为一次计划不顺就认定自己全盘败了，那以后再好的机会也很难真正抓住。
老店这些年不是败在味道上，而是败在更新太慢，很多年轻客人第一次来以后就不再回来。

example_translations.translation: The team led throughout the first half, but after making consecutive mistakes in the last ten minutes, it still lost to the more experienced opponent.
If you decide that you have completely failed just because one plan did not go smoothly, it becomes hard to truly seize even good opportunities later.
In recent years the old shop has not lost out because of its flavor, but because it updated too slowly, and many young customers never came back after their first visit.

glosses.notes: Means to pay a visit, often in a respectful or formal way.

examples.sentence: 这次出差时间虽然很紧，可是经理还是坚持抽出一个上午去拜访合作多年的老客户，当面听意见。
老师退休以后，过去的学生每到假期常常会约好一起去拜访他，顺便看看他新种的花。
记者在准备那篇人物报道的时候，先拜访了对方的同事和家人，希望把很多细节了解得更完整。

example_translations.translation: Although the schedule for this business trip was tight, the manager still insisted on taking one morning to visit a long-time client in person and hear their views.
After the teacher retired, former students often arranged to visit him together during holidays and also see the flowers he had recently planted.
While preparing that profile piece, the reporter first called on the person's colleagues and family, hoping to understand many of the details more fully.

glosses.primary_gloss: to pay a New Year's visit
glosses.notes: Means to pay a New Year's visit and exchange holiday greetings.

examples.sentence: 大年初一一早，孩子们穿好新衣服跟着父母去给外公外婆拜年，进门之前还先练了一遍要说的话。
因为今年不能回老家，他只好先跟家里视频拜年，等假期结束以后再找时间回去看看老人。
这几家人平常不算太熟，可是一到春节大家互相拜年，连住在楼上的那家人也很快就记住了。

example_translations.translation: Early on the first day of the New Year, the children put on new clothes and followed their parents to pay a New Year's visit to their grandparents, even practicing what they were going to say once before going in.
Because he could not return home this year, he had to offer New Year greetings to his family by video first, then find time to go back and see the elders after the holiday.
These families are not especially close in ordinary times, but once the Spring Festival comes and everyone pays New Year visits, even the family living upstairs quickly becomes familiar.

glosses.notes: Can mean an edition or version, and it is also the measure word used for printed editions.

examples.sentence: 出版社把教材的最新一版提前寄到学校以后，老师马上发现前一版里那个例子已经被换成了新的。
这部词典我先后买过两版，后一版把很多常见错误都改掉了，用起来明显比原来顺手。
负责做海报的人把海报做出第三版的时候，大家终于觉得颜色和字的比例都比较舒服，可以直接送去印。

example_translations.translation: After the publisher mailed the newest edition of the textbook to the school in advance, the teacher immediately noticed that the example in the previous edition had already been replaced with a new one.
I have bought two editions of this dictionary over the years, and the later edition corrected many common mistakes, making it noticeably easier to use than before.
By the time the person in charge of the poster had produced the third version, everyone finally felt that the colors and text proportions looked balanced enough to send it straight to print.

glosses.notes: Means a version of a text, product, program, or plan.

examples.sentence: 做这个程序的人连夜发了一个新版本，主要是把昨天用户一直抱怨的登录问题先处理掉，其他改动以后再说。
导演拿出了两个不同版本的结尾，让工作人员分别试看，想知道哪一种更能让观众记住这部片子。
老师要求我们交作业之前别只存一个版本，最好把修改前后的文件都留着，免得以后查不到。

example_translations.translation: The person who works on the program released a new version overnight, mainly to deal first with the login problem users had been complaining about yesterday, while leaving the other changes for later.
The director brought out two different versions of the ending and had the staff preview them separately, wanting to know which one would make the audience remember the film more.
The teacher told us not to save only one version before submitting our assignment; it was better to keep both the pre- and post-revision files in case we needed to check them later.

glosses.notes: Means to accompany something or happen along with it.

examples.sentence: 城市发展得越快，伴随而来的交通压力和住房问题往往也越明显，所以规划不能只看眼前。
孩子长大的过程中，伴随他的不只是成绩变化，还有性格和看事情的方式一点一点成熟起来。
每次天气变化的时候，她的过敏总会伴随一点鼻子不舒服，所以包里常常提前放好纸和药。

example_translations.translation: The faster a city develops, the more obvious the traffic pressure and housing problems that come along with it, so planning cannot focus only on the immediate present.
As a child grows up, what accompanies him is not just changes in grades, but also his personality and way of seeing things gradually becoming more mature.
Whenever the weather changes, her allergies always come with some nasal discomfort, so she often keeps tissues and medicine ready in her bag in advance.

glosses.notes: Means to play a role on stage or to act as something in a broader sense.

examples.sentence: 学校准备节目的时候，他原来只想帮大家搬东西，后来却被老师安排扮演故事里最重要的那个角色。
在整个计划里，这家小公司虽然人数不多，却扮演了连接设计和生产的关键角色。
父母在孩子学会判断之前，往往先扮演提醒和保护的角色，等他们慢慢长大以后才会一点一点放手。

example_translations.translation: When the school was preparing the performance, he originally wanted only to help move things, but later the teacher assigned him to play the most important role in the story.
In the entire plan, this small company did not have many people, but it acted as the key link between design and production.
Before children learn how to judge for themselves, parents often first play the role of reminding and protecting them, and only gradually let go as they grow older.

glosses.notes: Refers to an example or model worth learning from.

examples.sentence: 班长平常不爱多说话，可是轮到值日和集体活动总是第一个留下来，所以大家自然把他当成榜样。
教练说真正的榜样不是从来不出错的人，而是犯了错以后愿意马上改并且继续坚持的人。
她小时候一直把姐姐当榜样，所以后来想到专业和工作的时候，很多想法都多少受了影响。

example_translations.translation: The class monitor usually does not talk much, but whenever cleaning duty or a group activity comes up, he is the first to stay behind, so everyone naturally takes him as a model.
The coach said a true role model is not someone who never makes mistakes, but someone who is willing to correct them immediately and keep going.
She always treated her older sister as a role model when she was young, so later, whenever she thought about her major and work, many of her ideas were influenced by that.

glosses.notes: Means baseball, the sport played with a bat and ball.

examples.sentence: 学校新来的体育老师以前带过棒球队，所以他第一节课就把大家分成几个小组练最基本的接球动作。
弟弟本来只在电视上看过棒球比赛，真正站到场地上以后，才知道挥棒和在场上来回跑比想象中累得多。
周末那场棒球比赛虽然只是社区活动，可是来看的人很多，连旁边卖水的小店都提前多准备了一些水。

example_translations.translation: The school's new PE teacher had previously coached a baseball team, so in the very first class he divided everyone into small groups to practice the most basic catching movements.

My younger brother had only watched baseball games on television before, and only after standing on the field himself did he realize that swinging the bat and running back and forth on the field were far more tiring than he had imagined.
Even though that weekend baseball game was only a community event, many people came to watch, and even the little shop next door prepared some extra water in advance.

glosses.notes: Means to keep something safe or look after it carefully.

examples.sentence: 护照和票都先交给我保管吧，路上人多又乱，要是大家各自放着，反而更容易临时找不到。
爷爷把那封老信一直保管到现在，纸都已经发黄了，可是上面的字还是看得很清楚。
展览结束以后，这些借来的文物还要由工作人员继续保管，等全部检查完才能安全送回原处。

example_translations.translation: Let me keep the passports and tickets for everyone first; the trip will be crowded and chaotic, and if everyone keeps their own, it will actually be easier to lose track of them.
Grandpa has kept that old letter until now; the paper has already yellowed, but the writing on it is still very clear.
After the exhibition ends, these borrowed cultural objects still have to be kept by the staff, and only after everything is checked can they be safely sent back.

glosses.notes: Usually refers to health care or keeping the body healthy, often in formal settings or compounds.

examples.sentence: 社区每周都会开一节保健讲座，医生用大家听得懂的话提醒老人怎么吃药、怎么活动、怎么休息。
她母亲退休以后开始认真学保健知识，不但管自己的血压，也会提醒全家按时体检。
公司最近把原来的健身室改成了小型保健中心，希望员工工作再忙也能抽空看看身体。

example_translations.translation: The community holds a health-care lecture every week, and the doctor uses language everyone can understand to remind older people how to take medicine, exercise, and rest.
After her mother retired, she began seriously learning health-care knowledge; she not only managed her own blood pressure, but also reminded the whole family to get checkups on time.
The company recently converted its old fitness room into a small health-care center, hoping that even busy employees could spare time to check on their health.

glosses.notes: Means to keep warm or help someone or something stay warm.

examples.sentence: 山里早晚很容易变冷，带我们上山的人一再提醒我们先把外套穿好保暖，别觉得太阳出来了就立刻脱掉。
奶奶冬天出门前总会多围一条围巾保暖，因为她一着凉，晚上就很容易咳个不停。
工作人员看见孩子睡着了，马上拿来一条小被子给他保暖，还把旁边的门轻轻关上了。

example_translations.translation: In the mountains, it easily turns cold in the early morning and evening, so the person leading us up kept reminding us to put on our coats first to keep warm and not take them off the moment the sun came out.
Before going out in winter, Grandma always wraps on an extra scarf to keep warm, because once she gets chilled she coughs endlessly at night.
When the staff member saw the child had fallen asleep, they immediately brought over a small quilt to keep him warm and gently closed the nearby door as well.

glosses.notes: Means to guarantee repair within the stated warranty period.

examples.sentence: 他们解释得很清楚，只要在保修期内正常使用，这台机器出了问题就会负责检查和保修。
我买手机时最关心的不是颜色，而是保修时间够不够长，因为工作里差不多每天都要用到它。
电脑刚过一个月就出故障了，还好发票和保修卡都还在，不然来回沟通肯定更麻烦。

example_translations.translation: They explained very clearly that as long as the machine was used normally within the warranty period, they would handle the inspection and warranty repair if anything went wrong.
When I bought my phone, what I cared about most was not the color but whether the warranty period was long enough, because I use it at work almost every day.
The computer broke down after just one month, and it was a good thing the invoice and warranty card were both still there; otherwise all the back-and-forth would certainly have been more troublesome.
